root_cause.text: The driver unnecessarily gates the NOC_HDCP clock during HDCP power domain off transitions, which can cause a system hang due to the NoC ADB400 port requiring that clock to remain active for a proper power down handshake.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the `regmap_set_bits(bc->regmap, HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0, BIT(11))` from the power-on handler and the `regmap_clear_bits(bc->regmap, HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0, BIT(11))` from the power-off handler for `IMX8MP_HDMIBLK_PD_HDCP`. Instead, `BIT(11)` is added to the set of bits always enabled in `imx8mp_hdmi_power_notifier` (line `BIT(0) | BIT(1) | BIT(10) | BIT(11)`), ensuring the NOC_HDCP clock is kept active at all times. The commit message explicitly states: "Keep the NOC_HDCP clock always enabled to fix the potential hang caused by the NoC ADB400 port power down handshake."

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove an unnecessary register write during HDCP power on to fix potential incorrect behavior.
intent_record.what: Remove the entire case for IMX8MP_HDMIBLK_PD_HDCP from the switch statement in imx8mp_hdmi_blk_ctrl_power_on, which previously set bit 11 of HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0.
intent_record.how: When powering on the HDCP power domain, the function no longer performs the register write to set bit 11 of HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0. No action is taken for that domain, potentially avoiding incorrect hardware configuration.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove clearing of bit 11 in HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0 during HDCP power-off to avoid disrupting the clock control state, fixing a potential power management issue.
intent_record.what: Removed a case block for IMX8MP_HDMIBLK_PD_HDCP in imx8mp_hdmi_blk_ctrl_power_off that called regmap_clear_bits on HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0 with BIT(11).
intent_record.how: During power-off of the HDCP power domain, the function will no longer clear bit 11 of HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0, leaving that register bit unchanged instead of forcing it to zero.

intent_record.intent_summary: Set additional bit 11 in HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0 register during power notification.
intent_record.what: In imx8mp_hdmi_power_notifier, the regmap_set_bits call for HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0 now includes BIT(11) in addition to BIT(0), BIT(1), and BIT(10).
intent_record.how: The register HDMI_RTX_CLK_CTL0 now has bit 11 set along with the other three bits, which may enable an additional clock or control signal during HDMI power state changes.
